case.summary: Customer C08623 reported an unrecognized in-person transaction of $49.00 (3530164) on card C08623-K2 in region 330. Card activity revealed a legitimate in-person purchase in region 251 occurring only 1 hour and 22 minutes prior to transaction 3530056 and 2 hours and 10 minutes prior to transaction 3530164 in region 330, establishing physically impossible transit and cloned card use. Furthermore, card C08623-K2 has four prior confirmed-fraud closed cases exhibiting this exact out-of-region pattern. The episode was confirmed as out-of-region fraud with $165.93 in exposure across two transactions, warranting card blocking and case creation.
